title: Robust Mixture Regressions and EM Algorithms via the Log-Truncated Likelihood
abstract: arXiv:2611.30635v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Finite mixture regression is sensitive to gross residual outliers when component errors are modeled by Gaussian likelihoods. We propose a log-truncated likelihood for mixture regression. The likelihood is obtained by integrating a logarithmically growing Catoni-type score and exponentiating the negative integrated score, producing a proper location-scale density with a reusable normalizing constant and EM-compatible responsibilities. Although the induced density itself is lighter than exponential and has all moments, its likelihood score grows only logarithmically; this distinction yields a smooth residual-robust estimator that can be stably fitted when the data are generated from Laplace, Pareto, or even infinite-variance heavy-tailed error mechanisms. translated_title: 基于对数截断似然的稳健混合回归与EM算法
translated_abstract: 当分量误差采用高斯似然建模时，有限混合回归对严重残差离群值非常敏感。我们为混合回归提出了一种对数截断似然。该似然通过对呈对数增长的Catoni型得分函数进行积分，并对其负积分得分取指数而得到，从而产生一个具有可复用归一化常数且与EM算法兼容的责任权重的正规位置-尺度密度。尽管所导出的密度本身尾部轻于指数分布且拥有所有阶矩，但其似然得分仅呈对数增长；这一区别带来了一个平滑的残差稳健估计量，当数据由拉普拉斯、帕累托甚至无穷方差的重尾误差机制生成时，该估计量仍能稳定拟合。我们推导了确定性的尾部包络、归一化常数的位置-尺度分解、一个拒绝采样器、具有下界的混合权重更新，以及唯一的逐分量……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种对数截断似然用于混合回归，其似然得分仅呈对数增长，使得在拉普拉斯、帕累托甚至无穷方差重尾误差下仍能稳健稳定地拟合，并配套推导了尾部包络、拒绝采样器与下界混合权重更新等EM算法组件。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a log-truncated likelihood for mixture regression whose score grows only logarithmically, enabling robust and stable fitting under Laplace, Pareto, or even infinite-variance heavy-tailed error mechanisms, accompanied by tail envelopes, a rejection sampler, and lower-bounded mixing-weight updates for EM algorithms.
